title: A Voice Over the Boards

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: A slate burns on Slate Row and the boards carry it over the yard before the price of barley and after the weather; nobody stands under the voice to be asked. Bone is a month of repairs, and a repair that holds is not an account settled.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Clay Yard, told over the boards and at the kiln-mouth in Bone

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and three to three hundred and five days, six months and one hundred and twenty-three to one hundred and twenty-five days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. The surgeon's register colours the noticing and is never a break in the narration: the body inventoried as a wound of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold at cheek, temple and wrist and an afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform; the three counts in three places that do not become one; the carried fire kept in fours with its fifth unpaid and its payer unnamed; six hearings of the full note beside and never among with the seventh place kept empty; the heard bell in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night; the told figure beside the paid with Frost's three arithmetics locked in Berr Clay's box up the clay road, one in twelve printed and unchallenged and no signature on the space between, three readings three and not one account with the finding on a place of its own and no payer; the dressed grain turned beneath the wool with a progressively lighter touch and given no figure; the stayed frost gone off the well's north lip, the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice called weather and entered nowhere; the seven walked-around places gone around with a look and a wide step and no number; nine hands with Ilva's ninth strip unread and no tenth, the Frost 14 well-saying held at three shapings beside Hessa Rale's eighth hand, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Tarn's loan uncalled, Jorra's promise ungiven and he's not Vail sealed, Garl held in objects with his name unspoken, the burned-slate word held at four and shut-room tellings at two, and the house's not-doings kept on a place apart from the boy's own gaps with a finger between; and the six small coordinations of the hand entered on the sixth place and never promoted into a reach, a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power, a freedom, a gift, a doctrine or a rule. The old life stays offstage: no present-tense break, no tagged memory.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Fourth Morning of Bone
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{303}{Bone 4, Fourthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Fourthday with no market, Cross or bell. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on the one hundred and eightieth answer as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking; do not recap Chapter 83, the reader has just read it. Bone goes on without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months is set right or left wrong. Carry 302 to 303 exact, six months and one hundred and twenty-three days told by nobody — a threshold behind, not a milestone spoken over the basket (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and three days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken three hundred and three days (T009/T013/T092). Nothing seen in Bone 1–3 — not the fifth opening, not the hare, not Ilva's answering — is brought in as a sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment; five openings in five months are five and not a rule (T058/T079). Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, gone past the point where a child would eat it, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread and a basket set down is a pot set down and left; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform. He knows the composed face that is not composure, that a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before he is worse, and that a man must be warmed from the outside and slowly; he wants the crust lifted two inches and cannot close two inches on the pot handle, both true and the second louder, entered nowhere (T060/T086). Three counts in three places that do not become one: the kiln's four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should stand under the floor, the river's water over water at the finger's-width door, the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot. Keepings checked in order and unchanged: six hearings beside and never among with the seventh empty; the heard bell in its square beside the told; the told figure beside the paid with all three Frost arithmetics gone up the road and no signature on the space, three readings three and not one account with the finding on its own place and no payer; nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end; row at five askings with no witness; Frost 14 saying at three shapings beside Hessa's eighth hand; nine hands with Ilva's ninth unread; burned slate at four and shut-room tellings at two (T061/T082, T078, T015/T041/T047, T036/T076, T101, T080, T065/T095 held). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells the coals the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it* where another woman would say *I*, keeps her finger on top of the shelf so the charcoal stays unread, moves her lips along a two-gapped row with neither gap figured, glances once at the clay jar, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; the widow's mark is untouched because a morning is not an opening (T058/T079, T100). Tarn at the kindling keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, *Six counted. The next I don't count*, ear-sentence to the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in knuckle creases, pale clip-ring, stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, warm loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, loan uncalled, no collector up or down the road (T036/T076, T006). Jorra comes through the finger's-width shed with meal-fine grey dust past the bent finger, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the full note he knows three turns ahead, puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, gives men unnamed before first grey no name, keeps burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart, the row at five, *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise to the slate-burners neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064, T101 held). Garl stays in objects — salt-stiff coat, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line with the finer grey called the thaw, proverb said to pot and fire, uncalled tile debt. The hand takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his and lays it beside the kiln's fourth low pull without carrying it into the missing fifth. **Answer 181**, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air. The hand comes down on the river's note and the gap stays a gap.

scenes.title: Three Coverings, Called Weather
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 303, no new dated heading: afternoon of Bone 4 through the going of the light and into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the yard well and its flat stone, the drying racks and rack end, the worked strips as a direction, the kindling, the wheel-shed edge, the bed, boards and towel. Sella carries him down at the half-pace from every open slate with the fold over his ears against the river wind and the instruction going to the wool and the wind and never to the basket. She goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number: the clean dark line at the Vail corner and the finer grey hairline beside it called the thaw, unswept both; the space beneath the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates; the round ring where the shallow pan once stood with no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word; the skinned water in the trough; the field's empty place out on the worked strips; the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T060/T086). The stayed frost had gone off the well's north lip on Bone 3 while the yard was looking elsewhere; the trough wears its skin; the plate of ice lifted off it stands on the flat stone out of the path of feet, clouded with the silt that rose into it as it froze. Three coverings in three places, all called weather and entered nowhere, kept with a finger between every pair, no fourth likeness made a cause and no payer named — the stayed frost a covering over a depth, the skinned water the same covering over another depth, the clouded plate a piece of the depth lifted and set where no foot goes (T083/T085 held). At the rack end the dressed grain lies under wool away from the hearth; she lifts a corner and turns it beneath the wool with a touch lighter than the morning's and gives it no figure, and the three Frost readings that went over it are not brought in as lessons — the figure read is still not the figure paid and the space between them has no signature (T077). Bone's hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures: men come down from Cold Acre with hares across their shoulders and the cost asked of the month is answered with the weather and a direction that leaves no entry; do not single out the earlier hunter or give him a second appearance — he is the month's trade, not a procession and not a thread (T077 advanced, not paid). Tarn keeps the ear-sentence stopped at the calling word as a remembered stopping with no tenth and no collector, wants the late thaw because it puts off the paying, and his stroke goes over the bright patch without the half-check; Jorra keeps grey dust and silence with the bent finger leading at the damper (T036/T076, T035/T031/T062 held). Sella at the going of the light: fire before basket, thaw, broken pot, *The house will keep it*, charcoal unread, two gaps unfigured, clay jar glanced at once, pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow's mark untouched because a going of the light is not an opening (T058/T079, T100). The hand sets an empty interval beside a held interval, brings the finger down between them and takes it up, leaving both where they were. **Answer 182**, a keeping and not a spending, exact, worth nothing, no doctrine. Exact last image: the clouded plate of ice standing on the flat stone out of the path of feet, the hand coming down on the river's note and the gap left a gap.

scenes.title: A Repair That Holds
scenes.synopsis: Third entry, third dated \daymark{304}{Bone 5, Fifthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail roof into the first light of an ordinary Fifthday, at the hearth, the pot board, the loaf shelf, the bed, the boards and the towel. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Bone 4 — not the three coverings, not the turned grain, not the hare's carrying — is brought in as a lesson, sign, mending, witness or payment. Carry 303 to 304 exact, six months and one hundred and twenty-four days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and four days, payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken three hundred and four days (T009/T013/T092). Bone is the month of hunts and repairs judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never by a figure (T077); the ordinary tending holds. Under the kiln-house a broken pot whose handle has been mended twice stands on the pot board; the proverb about mending twice, and Garl's saying to leave the crack showing, go to the pot and the fire and never to a person — repair is not restoration, and a mended vessel carries its break (T009/T013/T092, T060/T086). Body inventory renewed in the old order: one crust two inches off with its unnamed empty place and no third; frozen thread unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a written line; the afterdrop beyond a warming nobody will perform. The ease cold puts on a face is not ease; a cold patient cannot clot; a man must be warmed from the outside and slowly. He wants the crust lifted and cannot close two inches on the pot handle; both true, second louder, and the surgeon's knowing buys nothing at two inches of air (T060/T086). Keepings unchanged and not brought forward: three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings with the seventh empty; heard bell beside told; told figure beside paid with Frost's three arithmetics locked up the road, three readings three and not one account, finding on its own place with no payer; nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end; row at five askings; well-saying at three shapings beside the eighth hand; nine hands with Ilva's ninth unread; burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart, seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape with no eighth (T061/T082, T078, T015/T041/T047, T036/T076, T101, T080, T065/T095, T064, T050/T051, T033/T034 held). Sella to the fire before the basket, thaw, back of a broken pot, *The house will keep it*, finger above the charcoal, lips along the two-gapped row, clay jar glanced at once, pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; widow's mark untouched because a morning is not an opening and five openings in five months are five and not a rule (T058/T079, T100). At the fire she stands a moment with the back of the pot in her hand counting under her breath toward no opening — small intake, hold, letting-go. The hand takes the half-beat between Sella's setting the pot down and going away and lays it beside a small intake from the next room on two places with a finger between, neither spent. **Answer 183** — exact, complete, worth nothing, no reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, gift, doctrine or rule. Exact last image: the pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with its handle turned toward it and the half-beat unfigured before Sella went away without a look toward the bed.

scenes.title: The Fifth Telling
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: afternoon of Bone 5 through the going of the light and into the small hours at the Clay Yard, over the boards, toward the terrace that leads to Slate Row, and at the wheel-shed edge. **THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, ADVANCED AND NOT PAID (T035/T031/T065/T095):** an ownerless voice comes up from Slate Row over the boards of the yard, not to the basket, saying that a slate was burned on Slate Row again. There is no owner standing under the voice, no room, no hand at the flame and no reason; the voice comes on the same breath as the price of barley and the weather, and goes off up the terrace while the yard goes on with its work. The boy takes it apart as a surgeon takes a wound apart — by what is there and what is not — and sets it on a place of its own beside the four burned-slate tellings (Ember 25, the telling between, Grain 5 and Grain 8) with a finger between every pair. It is a **fifth telling of the burned slate** and still **not a third telling of the counting room shut in the war**, which stands at two; no witness stands anywhere to be asked, so it is not a hearing, not a seventh, not a stopping, not a payment, not a cause, not a confession, not a joining, not a rule and not paid. Five are five and not a rule; a row filled in to make it come out even is a row forged. The seed is held for the far-off day Jorra's promise to the men who burn slates is called in, not a confession and not a payment; Bone 10 (Day 309) and its first reading must be able to carry it unchanged. Jorra, who knows the full note a slate-burner's pot gives before it leaves his hands and who has withheld it from a High Kiln kiln-master, grows quieter whenever the saying goes around the boards; *he's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise of the foundling's name is neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095 advanced, not paid). Sella carries him down at the half-pace from every open slate, goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T077), turns the dressed grain beneath the wool with a lighter touch and no figure, and tells the fire the thaw when the sour breath comes off the unswept corner (T058/T079). The stayed frost, skinned trough and clouded plate stay weather entered nowhere with no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085 held). Tarn keeps six and a seventh held, the ear-sentence stopped with no tenth, the loan uncalled and no collector on the road (T036/T076). The hand holds the little interval between the voice and the weather's answer as an empty interval on its own place and does not fill it to make a row come out even. **Answer 184**, exact, worth nothing, no payer named. Exact last image: the voice going off up the terrace while the boards stand with the fifth telling kept apart from the four and a finger between it and them.

scenes.title: The Crack Left Showing
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry, fifth dated \daymark{305}{Bone 6, Sixthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail roof into the first light of an ordinary Sixthday, at the hearth, the loaf shelf, the bed, the boards and the towel. New day, new date, no recap; the burned-slate saying from Bone 5 is not brought in as a sign, lesson, mending, cause or fifth of a rule — five are five, and a sixth is not due (T035/T031/T065/T095 held, not paid). Carry 304 to 305 exact, six months and one hundred and twenty-five days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and five days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken three hundred and five days (T009/T013/T092). Bone's ordinary repair work holds, judged by the arm and the weather and never by a figure (T077). A pot set on the pot board carries its twice-mended handle with the repair standing visible; the crack left showing is kept as Garl's proverb said it, said to the pot and the fire and never to a person — a repair that holds is not restoration and mends nothing anybody will name (T009/T013/T092, T058/T079). Body inventory renewed in the old order: one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, its empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped; cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody will perform. The surgeon knows the composed face that is not composure and that a cold patient will seem better before he is worse; the infant wants the crust lifted and the thread wiped; both voices argue and neither wins, and the argument is the work (T060/T086). Sella to the fire before the basket, tells it the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it*, keeps her finger above the charcoal so the tally stays unread, moves her lips along a row with two gaps and figures neither, glances once at the clay jar, sets the pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs, untouched because a morning is not an opening (T058/T079, T100). The hand outside the wool goes up an inch toward the river's note, takes a small intake from the next room and lets it go whole on the same note — a restraint and not a payment, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air. **Answer 185.** Exact last image: the stiff leathery crust two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, and cold stopped at cheek, temple and the small bare joint of the wrist with the afterdrop waiting beyond.

scenes.title: The File Left Open
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 305, Bone 6, the going of the light and the small hours at the Clay Yard, yard well and flat stone, rack end, kindling, wheel-shed edge, bed, boards and towel. Bone goes on without a boundary drawn and neither habit of naming the months is corrected; the yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, and the month's hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T077). The stayed frost, skinned trough and clouded plate of ice stay weather entered nowhere, three coverings in three places with a finger between and no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085 held). Frost's three arithmetics with their true subtractions ride locked up the clay road in Berr Clay's box toward High Kiln, one in twelve printed and unchallenged, figure read still not figure paid, no signature on the space; three readings are three and not one account, and the finding sits on a place of its own with no payer, not a lesson, grievance, mending or doctrine and not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain or the boy's own kept gaps — edges nearly touching and the finger going between (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082). **Ilva once at the well:** drawing with the pail against her knee, clay dried pale in the crescents of her nails and grey rack dust in the seam of one thumb she does not scrub out; asked what the month's firings have taken, her hand goes toward her sleeve and stays there, the notched birch strip not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to any slate and no figure coming off the wood; her eyes go to the asker and her mouth opens after both: *Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account.* The boy takes the order of reaching and files **no tenth**; the ninth stays nine with a finger between it and the eighth, and nothing of the well goes under the roof as lesson, figure, mending, cause or payment (T080 held and advanced, not paid). Tarn at the kindling keeps six in the thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, *Six counted. The next I don't count*, the ear-sentence stopped at the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in the knuckle creases, pale clip-ring, stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, warm loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, loan uncalled, no collector up or down the road (T036/T076, T006). Jorra comes through the finger's-width shed with meal-fine grey dust past the bent finger, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the full note he knows three turns ahead on the near-full tray beside the hearings and never among them, puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, gives the men unnamed before first grey no name and does not say the room is cold; burned slate now five with a finger between it and the four, shut-room tellings at two, pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, *he's not Vail* sealed, promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064, T101 held). Garl stays in objects with his name unspoken three hundred and five days, the salt-stiff coat, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line and finer grey, proverb said to pot and fire, uncalled tile debt worse for being uncalled (T009/T013/T092). Small keepings stay small and are not brought forward: Ilva's strip, the three shapings of the Frost 14 well-saying beside Hessa's eighth hand, the row at five, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the charcoal under the shelf unread, the reed-cutter's cord where no Court thumb has read it, the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called — none a sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment (T080, T101, T050/T051, T033/T034, T100, T099, T090 held). Sella's last grammar: fire before basket, thaw, broken pot, *The house will keep it*, charcoal unread, two gaps unfigured, clay jar glanced at once, pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow's mark untouched because a going of the light is not an opening and five openings in five months are five and not a rule (T058/T079, T100). He turns out the file as he once turned instruments out on a towel and finds every gap left gap. At the very end of the day the hand takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his and lets it go whole on the river's low note, not carried into the fire's missing fifth, the bell's gap left in the square or the river's low over lower. **Answer 186**, exact, complete, worth nothing, promoted into no reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power, freedom, gift, doctrine or rule, no payer named. Ledger close: **305** exact, six months and 125 days told by nobody; fire's fifth unpaid 305 days, payer unnamed; Garl's name unspoken 305 days; **186** honest answers on the sixth place, each an object and not a power, and neither number nor hand-movings standing up as a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood. The hand laid itself back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. Bone 10 (Day 309), the month's first Account-day and market, stands four mornings ahead and is not brought into a day that has not earned it. Exact last image: the file lying open on the towel at the head of the bed with every gap left gap, every tray parted by a finger's width and nothing moved; the river's low note going quiet under the finger's-width door, the plate of ice standing clouded with silt on its flat stone out of the path of feet, and Bone going on without a boundary drawn.
